name: Monsters DB
body:
The database below contains only Open Game Content. In the vast majority of cases nothing needed to be changed but in a few cases, a name or reference to a character from the official Pathfinder Campaign Setting may have been renamed, or had the name removed to make the spell, item, feat, trait, or monster, compliant with the Open Game License.

A version of this database which includes “official” content is available at pathfindercommunity.net.

Open in a New Window
